title: The Menu, Week 8
dek: Josh Allen comes off the bye at QB1, Bijan Robinson takes RB1 and Lamar Jackson returns at QB4.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Thu 12:20 PM ET: Matthew Golden is reported trending toward playing tonight and stays WR11; Michael Wilson (ribs) was limited and Tyler Allgeier (toe) missed Wednesday, both Monitor until the Cardinals' reports.

Updated Wed 7:15 PM ET: Matthew Golden is questionable for Thursday after a limited practice and stays WR11 until the inactives; Lamar Jackson practiced in full at QB4; Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder), Amon-Ra St. Brown, Jaylen Waddle and Aaron Jones Sr. sat out Wednesday and hold their spots until Thursday's and Friday's reports.

Updated Wed 10:55 AM ET: Jaylen Waddle (chest, shoulder) is WR41 and Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) RB33 for me until Friday's injury reports; the rest of the order stands ahead of Wednesday's practices.

Updated Tue 7:55 PM ET: the Week 8 order is refreshed ahead of Wednesday's practice reports.

Week 8 has four teams on bye: Houston, New Orleans, the Giants and San Francisco are off, so none of their players are on the Menu. Carolina at Green Bay opens the week Thursday night, Philadelphia at Washington is Sunday night and Chicago at Seattle closes it Monday night. Rankings are for full PPR.

Josh Allen comes off the bye at QB1 with Drake Maye right behind him, and Lamar Jackson is back at QB4 after three missed games. Bijan Robinson edges Jahmyr Gibbs for RB1, Jaxon Smith-Njigba is WR1 after 150 yards vs KC, and Trey McBride is TE1 after 13 targets vs DEN.

Prep Notes revisits Friday: Lamar Jackson's ankle, Saquon Barkley's back, Matthew Golden before Thursday night, Amon-Ra St. Brown's ankle, Breece Hall's return and Jeremiyah Love at practice.
